text_block_list.text:
To test their real-world manners, Gold 
Ship and Winning Ticket board a train. All 
they have to do is ride it normally, but—

—The two of them dropped out. Society is 
harsh, after all. At the same time, Gold 
Ship learned an important lesson: Never 
forget that dolphins are mammals!

Once again in her dream, Gold Ship heard a 
voice guiding her. It sounded like Mejiro 
McQueen, yet somewhat different...

From Mejiro McQueen, Gold Ship smelled the 
tatami mats of grandpa's house, and from 
the voice in her dream, the smell of socks 
after a hard day's work.
